decisions.reason: Blocked is correct reporting, not completed implementation; blocker specificity and simulator-vs-store distinction preserved.

P0-first milestone retained; blanket P3/P4 ban rejected because minimum security/governance/accessibility belongs in P0. Separate deterministic/live/native evidence, and do not force session termination once P0 passes.
Local real PostgreSQL/queue is valid local correctness evidence; it does not prove managed auth/RLS/storage/pooler/native compatibility or real model quality.

Define completionEpoch, typed uniqueness and per-binding delivery identity. A local key cannot guarantee duplicate-free external push; reconcile/suppress unknown sends and retain privacy-safe foreground sync.
Implement baseline before breadth, but twelve deterministic smoke cases do not prove live/native or every critical invariant.
Complete P1-P3 as gated; evaluate adaptive/incremental complexity rather than automatically shipping an experimental mechanism that fails its own comparison.
Use real consented tasks/independent evidence before meaningful product evaluation or numerical readiness/marketing claims. Draft cases remain unchanged and unexecuted.
Link Grok capability row to account-entitlement evaluation gate; no new feature claim.
Parallel branches remain conditional measured experiment; no mandatory six-call runtime chain.
F04/F06 were resolved in existing specification text; app implementation and runtime tests remain unperformed.
